output.question: What acquisitions has Johnson & Johnson made?
output.answer: Johnson & Johnson’s recent completed acquisitions include Firefly Bio ($1 billion, July 29, 2026) and Atraverse Medical (second quarter of 2026; financial terms undisclosed). In 2025, it acquired Halda Therapeutics (December 26; approximately $3.05 billion) and Intra-Cellular Therapies (April 2; $14.5 billion in total consideration). Its 2024 acquisitions included V-Wave, Yellow Jersey—the company holding global rights to NM26—Proteologix, Shockwave Medical and Ambrx Biopharma. It also acquired Laminar in 2023. Earlier major acquisitions include Abiomed (2022), Actelion (2017) and Synthes (2012); this is a selected overview, not an exhaustive acquisition history.

key_facts.fact: Firefly Bio acquisition completed July 29, 2026, for $1 billion in cash, as reported on that date.
Atraverse Medical acquisition completed in the second quarter of 2026; the updated announcement does not disclose financial terms.
Halda Therapeutics acquisition completed December 26, 2025, for approximately $3.05 billion net of cash acquired, as reported for the period ended September 27, 2026.
Intra-Cellular Therapies acquisition completed April 2, 2025, for $14.5 billion in total consideration, as reported for the period ended September 27, 2026.
Completed 2024 acquisitions included V-Wave on October 8, Yellow Jersey on July 11, Proteologix on June 20, Shockwave Medical on May 31, and Ambrx Biopharma on March 7.
